verdict.rationale: Make documents URL-path API versioning (/api/v2, 'currently the second version'), and an OpenAPI 3.0.0 document titled 'Web API v2' describes it, so the versioned-API half of the story is delivered. The same docs state that no deprecation policy, stability guarantee, breaking-change policy or changelog is published, so the core reliability promise is not met. missing for 10: a documented deprecation policy, breaking-change and stability guarantees, a public API changelog, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: The URL of the Make API consists of three parts: https://{zone_url}/api/{api_version}/{api_endpoint}
API version: The version of the API. The Make API is currently the second version.
Make's public Web API v2 is described by a machine-readable OpenAPI 3.0.0 document
